label: Azaca system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an Azaca locus represented by ZacA, ZacB, and ZacC profiles that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Azaca branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual zacA, zacB, or zacC genes, ZacA, ZacB, or ZacC proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Azaca locus, unresolved Azaca trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
